note: Needs the LAN Firecrawl server and a real Chat model; I did not change the network allowlist (a security setting) in the sandbox. Steps: Capabilities › Connectors › Advanced setup › Web & Search; set Self-hosted base URL to the LAN Firecrawl address, add its host to the allowlist if asked (approve), Save Firecrawl, then Test connection; then in Chat (Web access on) ask a question that needs a web page. Code check: the key is only stored after a passing check (web-search-credential-service.ts:185).
